explanation: Reads feminine grammatical gender off a noun-phrase specifier or its agreeing adjective: the pole fires at 2-4 of its 3.97 max on the feminine article, demonstrative, possessive or quantifier of a Romance noun phrase (' la', 'La', 'una', 'une', 'uma', 'esta', 'esa', 'cette', 'nella', 'della', 'alla', 'delle', 'nuestra', 'aquella', 'mucha') and on the subword carrying the -a of a feminine adjective ('buena', 'nuova', 'primera', 'dodicesima'), plus German feminine 'die'/'eine'/'zur' and the weak adjective ending '-ische(n)'; the masculine counterpart of the same word in the same frame ('le', 'el', 'este', 'ce', 'il', 'un', 'um', 'nuestro', 'aquel', 'mucho', 'der', 'das') stays at 0.00-0.50. It is retrospective: the activation is fixed by the gender feature of the token already read and is unmoved by the noun that follows ('Veo la casa' = 'Veo la ciudad' = 'Veo la capital' = 2.21), while its output direction promotes 'other'/'else' only where 'other' is already the top candidate ('each other' 0.81 -> 0.39 without the pole, 'on the other hand' 0.10 -> 0.02) and changes nothing measurable at the Romance peaks (KL ~1e-6).
